name: Legacy: Tokens Over Time

queries.name: main
queries.sql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(OccurredAt) AS bucket,
  sum(PromptTokens) AS prompt_tokens,
  sum(CompletionTokens) AS completion_tokens
FROM trace_metrics
WHERE OccurredAt >= {period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {period_end:DateTime}
  AND TotalDurationMs > 0
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket
